description: Transform the web build into an installable Progressive Web App with offline support and custom install prompts

requirements.description: Build pipeline generates PWA icons from source asset
steps: Run 'npm run generate:icons' command
Verify 'public/icons/' directory is created
Check that 9 PNG files are generated: icon-72.png, icon-96.png, icon-128.png, icon-144.png, icon-152.png, icon-192.png, icon-384.png, icon-512.png, icon-512-maskable.png
Verify maskable icon has proper safe zone padding (40%)
Confirm all icons have #fdde97 background color

requirements.description: Build pipeline generates web app manifest with correct paths
steps: Set GITHUB_PAGES=true environment variable
Run 'npm run generate:manifest' command
Verify 'dist/manifest.json' file is created
Check that start_url is '/tictacdoh/' when GITHUB_PAGES=true
Check that start_url is '/' when GITHUB_PAGES is not set
Verify scope matches start_url
Confirm all 9 icon paths are correctly formatted with base path

requirements.description: Build pipeline generates service worker with Workbox
steps: Run 'npm run generate:sw' command after expo export
Verify 'dist/sw.js' file is created
Check that service worker includes precache manifest
Verify large audio files are excluded from precache (setup-music.mp3, game-setup-music.mp3)
Confirm runtime caching rules are defined for images, audio, and fonts

requirements.description: Complete build pipeline executes all steps in correct order
steps: Run 'npm run build' command
Verify icons are generated first
Confirm expo export completes successfully
Check that manifest.json is generated after export
Verify service worker is generated last
Ensure no build errors occur
Confirm dist/ directory contains all required files: index.html, manifest.json, sw.js, icons/

requirements.description: Web app manifest loads correctly with all required fields
steps: Build and serve the app locally with 'npx http-server dist -p 8080'
Open browser DevTools → Application → Manifest
Verify manifest loads without errors
Check name: 'Tic-Tac-Doh - A Doughy Tic-Tac-Toe Game'
Check short_name: 'Tic-Tac-Doh'
Check display: 'standalone'
Check theme_color: '#fdde97'
Check background_color: '#fdde97'
Verify all 9 icons are listed and accessible (no 404s)

requirements.description: Service worker registers successfully on app load
steps: Serve the app locally
Open browser DevTools → Application → Service Workers
Load the app in browser
Verify service worker registers (shows as 'activated and running')
Check console for 'Service Worker registered' message
Verify service worker scope matches base path
Confirm no registration errors in console

requirements.description: Service worker precaches critical app shell resources
steps: Register service worker and wait for installation
Open DevTools → Application → Cache Storage
Verify precache exists (workbox-precache-v2-... cache)
Check that HTML files are cached (index.html)
Check that CSS bundle is cached
Check that JS bundle is cached (~1.8MB)
Verify small assets are precached

requirements.description: Service worker caches audio files with runtime caching
steps: Load the app and navigate through game
Play audio (background music and sound effects)
Open DevTools → Application → Cache Storage
Verify 'audio-cache' exists
Check that MP3 files are cached after playback
Confirm large music files (setup-music.mp3, game-setup-music.mp3) are in audio cache

requirements.description: App works completely offline after initial load
steps: Load the app online and wait for service worker activation
Navigate through all screens (setup, play, options)
Play at least one game to trigger audio loading
Open DevTools → Network → Enable 'Offline' mode
Reload the page
Verify app loads from cache without errors
Navigate through all screens offline
Play a complete game offline
Verify audio plays offline
Check that no network errors appear in console

requirements.description: PWA meta tags are present in HTML head
steps: View page source of dist/index.html
Verify <link rel='manifest'> tag exists with correct path
Check <meta name='theme-color'> is set to '#fdde97'
Verify <meta name='apple-mobile-web-app-capable'> is 'yes'
Check <meta name='apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style'> exists
Verify <link rel='apple-touch-icon'> tags exist for 152px and 192px
Confirm <meta name='mobile-web-app-capable'> is 'yes'

requirements.description: Install prompt appears after 30 seconds of engagement
steps: Clear browser cache and localStorage
Load the app in Chrome browser (desktop or Android)
Wait for beforeinstallprompt event to be captured
Wait 30 seconds without interaction
Verify custom install prompt appears at bottom of screen
Check prompt shows 'Install Tic-Tac-Doh' message
Verify 'Install' and 'Not Now' buttons are visible
Confirm prompt styling matches game theme (dough background, outline border)

requirements.description: Install prompt triggers native installation flow
steps: Wait for custom install prompt to appear
Click 'Install' button
Verify native browser install dialog appears
Confirm installation
Check that app installs to system (appears in app drawer/start menu)
Verify custom prompt disappears after installation

requirements.description: Install prompt dismissal persists across sessions
steps: Wait for custom install prompt to appear
Click 'Not Now' button
Verify prompt disappears
Check that '@tic-tac-doh/install-prompt-dismissed' is set to 'true' in AsyncStorage
Reload the page
Wait 30+ seconds
Verify install prompt does NOT reappear
Clear AsyncStorage/localStorage and reload
Confirm prompt reappears after 30 seconds

requirements.description: Installed PWA launches in standalone mode
steps: Install the PWA using install prompt or browser menu
Launch the installed app from home screen/start menu
Verify app opens without browser chrome (no address bar, no tabs)
Check that app displays in full-screen standalone mode
Verify theme color (#fdde97) applies to status bar/title bar
Confirm app name 'Tic-Tac-Doh' appears in title bar

requirements.description: App is installable on Chrome Desktop
steps: Open app in Chrome browser on Windows/Mac/Linux
Check that install icon appears in address bar (omnibox)
Click install icon or use menu → Install Tic-Tac-Doh
Verify installation completes successfully
Launch installed app
Confirm app works in standalone mode

requirements.description: App is installable on Android Chrome
steps: Open app in Chrome browser on Android device
Check that install banner appears or menu shows 'Install app'
Tap install option
Verify app installs to home screen
Launch app from home screen
Confirm app opens in standalone mode
Verify splash screen shows correct icon and colors

requirements.description: App can be added to iOS Home Screen
steps: Open app in Safari on iOS device
Tap Share button → 'Add to Home Screen'
Verify icon preview shows correctly
Confirm app name 'Tic-Tac-Doh' is displayed
Tap 'Add' to install
Launch app from home screen
Verify app opens in standalone mode (no Safari UI)
Check that status bar style is correct

requirements.description: Base path handling works for local development
steps: Build app without GITHUB_PAGES environment variable
Verify manifest.json start_url is '/'
Serve locally with 'npx http-server dist -p 8080'
Load app at http://localhost:8080
Verify manifest loads from http://localhost:8080/manifest.json
Check that all icons load correctly
Confirm service worker registers with scope '/'
Test installation works locally

requirements.description: Base path handling works for GitHub Pages deployment
steps: Build app with GITHUB_PAGES=true environment variable
Verify manifest.json start_url is '/tictacdoh/'
Deploy to GitHub Pages
Load app at https://chrisstoy.github.io/tictacdoh/
Verify manifest loads from https://chrisstoy.github.io/tictacdoh/manifest.json
Check that all icon URLs include /tictacdoh/ base path
Confirm service worker registers with scope '/tictacdoh/'
Test installation works on deployed site

requirements.description: Lighthouse PWA audit score is 90 or higher
steps: Serve the app (locally or deployed)
Open Chrome DevTools → Lighthouse
Select 'Progressive Web App' category
Run audit
Verify overall PWA score is ≥ 90
Check 'Installable' section passes all checks
Verify 'PWA Optimized' section passes
Confirm 'Fast and reliable' checks pass

requirements.description: Precache size is optimized (under 5MB)
steps: Build the app and generate service worker
Open DevTools → Application → Cache Storage after SW installation
Check precache storage size
Verify total precache is approximately 2.3MB
Confirm large audio files are NOT in precache
Check that only essential app shell is precached

requirements.description: Repeat visits load instantly from cache
steps: Load app and wait for service worker activation
Open DevTools → Network tab
Enable 'Disable cache' option temporarily, then disable it
Reload the page
Verify most resources show '(from ServiceWorker)' or '(from disk cache)'
Check that page load time is under 1 second
Confirm no network requests for cached resources

requirements.description: Service worker registration integrates with app lifecycle
steps: Check that registerServiceWorker is imported in src/app/_layout.tsx
Verify registration happens in useEffect hook
Load the app and check console for registration message
Confirm registration only occurs on web platform (not iOS/Android native)
Verify SSR safety checks prevent server-side execution
Check that app functions normally before SW activation

requirements.description: Install prompt component integrates with app UI
steps: Check that PWAInstallPrompt is imported in src/app/index.tsx
Verify component is rendered at bottom of main View
Load the app and wait for prompt to appear
Navigate between screens (setup, play, options)
Verify prompt stays visible across screen transitions
Confirm prompt appears above all other UI elements
Check that prompt doesn't interfere with game interactions

requirements.description: GitHub Actions workflow builds and deploys PWA
steps: Push changes to main branch
Wait for GitHub Actions workflow to run
Verify build step completes without errors
Check that all 4 build steps execute (icons, export, manifest, SW)
Confirm dist/ artifact is uploaded
Verify deployment to GitHub Pages succeeds
Load deployed site and confirm PWA functionality works

requirements.description: Existing game functionality remains intact
steps: Load the app (with PWA features)
Test player selection (human vs human, human vs CPU, CPU vs CPU)
Play a complete match with multiple rounds
Verify score tracking works correctly
Test all sound effects and background music
Navigate to options and toggle settings
Verify auto-replay functionality works
Confirm all existing features work as before

requirements.description: iOS and Android native builds are unaffected
steps: Run 'npm run ios' to start iOS simulator
Verify iOS app builds and runs without errors
Run 'npm run android' to start Android emulator
Verify Android app builds and runs without errors
Check that PWA-specific code doesn't execute on native platforms
Confirm native app functionality is unchanged

requirements.description: Service worker registration handles unsupported browsers gracefully
steps: Mock a browser without service worker support
Load the app
Verify console shows 'Service workers are not supported' message
Confirm app still functions normally without PWA features
Check that no errors are thrown

requirements.description: Install prompt handles browsers without beforeinstallprompt
steps: Open app in Safari (which doesn't support beforeinstallprompt)
Wait 30+ seconds
Verify custom install prompt does NOT appear
Confirm no console errors related to install prompt
Check that app functions normally

requirements.description: Service worker updates are detected and handled
steps: Load app with service worker v1
Make a code change and rebuild
Deploy updated version
Reload the page with old SW active
Verify 'updatefound' event is triggered
Check console for 'New content available' message
Hard reload to activate new service worker
Confirm updated content is served

requirements.description: All icon sizes are valid and properly formatted
steps: Inspect public/icons/ directory after generation
Verify each icon file is valid PNG format
Verify maskable icon has 512x512 dimensions
Open each icon in image viewer to confirm content is visible
Check that icon content is properly centered

requirements.description: Manifest JSON is valid and well-formed
steps: Open dist/manifest.json in text editor
Validate JSON syntax (no parsing errors)
Verify all required fields are present
Check that icon paths are properly formatted
Confirm start_url and scope are valid URIs
Verify display, orientation, and colors are valid values
Run manifest through online PWA manifest validator

requirements.description: Service worker is valid JavaScript
steps: Open dist/sw.js in text editor
Verify file contains valid JavaScript code
Check that Workbox runtime is included
Confirm precache manifest is populated with hashed assets
Verify runtime caching routes are defined
Check that no syntax errors exist

requirements.description: Service worker only serves cached content from same origin
steps: Inspect service worker fetch event handlers
Verify service worker only caches same-origin requests
Check that CORS is properly handled for cross-origin assets
Confirm no sensitive data is cached
Verify cache keys include version information

requirements.description: Install prompt is accessible via keyboard navigation
steps: Wait for install prompt to appear
Use Tab key to navigate to install prompt
Verify both 'Install' and 'Not Now' buttons can be focused
Press Enter on each button to confirm they activate
Check that focus indicators are visible
Verify screen reader announces prompt content

requirements.description: Build scripts are documented and executable
steps: Run 'npm run generate:icons' independently
Run 'npm run generate:manifest' independently
Run 'npm run generate:sw' independently
Run complete 'npm run build' pipeline
Verify each script has clear console output
Check that error messages are helpful if scripts fail
